diapositivas.codigoAnimacion:
<a-entity id="escena_estudio" position="0 0 0" scale="0.12 0.12 0.12">

    <!-- 1. ILUMINACIÓN COMPLETA DE ESTUDIO (Nitidez y sombras para todas las figuras) -->
    <a-light type="ambient" color="#ffffff" intensity="1.1"></a-light>
    <a-light type="directional" color="#ffffff" intensity="1.3" position="0 5 4"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#38bdf8" intensity="1.8" distance="12" position="-2 2 3"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#fbbf24" intensity="1.5" distance="12" position="2 2 3"></a-light>

    <!-- 2. PLATAFORMA DE CALIBRACIÓN CIENTÍFICA (En el suelo) -->
    <a-entity position="0 -1.9 0">
        <!-- Cuadrante de medición milimétrica concéntrico -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="3.2" radius-outer="3.4" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.8; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -90 360 0; dur: 30000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-ring>
        <a-ring radius-inner="2.4" radius-outer="2.55" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.7; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -90 -360 0; dur: 22000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-ring>
        <a-ring radius-inner="1.6" radius-outer="1.72" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #34d399; emissive: #059669; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true; side: double">
        </a-ring>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 3. FIGURA EXACTA: MICROSCOPIO CIENTÍFICO DE ALTA PRECISIÓN (Observación / Derecha Abajo) -->
    <a-entity position="3.3 -0.8 0.2" rotation="0 -30 0"
        animation="property: rotation; to: 0 -15 0; dir: alternate; dur: 4000; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Base semicircular pesada -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.75" height="0.12" position="0 0 0" material="color: #1e293b; metalness: 0.7; roughness: 0.3"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.6" height="0.08" position="0 0.1 0" material="color: #0f172a; metalness: 0.8; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Brazo Curvo Metálico -->
        <a-box width="0.22" height="1.5" depth="0.25" position="-0.4 0.85 0" rotation="0 0 -15" material="color: #334155; metalness: 0.8; roughness: 0.2"></a-box>
        <!-- Platina mecánica con clip porta-muestras -->
        <a-box width="0.95" height="0.05" depth="0.85" position="0.05 0.75 0" material="color: #020617; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.1"></a-box>
        <!-- Portaobjetos de cristal transparente -->
        <a-box width="0.65" height="0.015" depth="0.25" position="0.05 0.79 0" material="color: #a5f3fc; opacity: 0.55; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.9"></a-box>
        <!-- Muestra celular fluorescente examinada -->
        <a-circle radius="0.07" position="0.05 0.805 0" rotation="-90 0 0" material="color: #22c55e; emissive: #16a34a; emissiveIntensity: 1"></a-circle>
        <!-- Condensador y Fuente de Luz bajo la platina -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.16" height="0.25" position="0.05 0.6 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Revólver con 3 Objetivos Lentes (10x, 40x, 100x) -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.32" height="0.1" position="0.05 1.45 0" material="color: #475569; metalness: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.35" position="0.05 1.25 0.15" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.4" position="0.05 1.25 -0.15" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.45" position="-0.1 1.25 0" material="color: #38bdf8; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Tubo Óptico y Ocular Inclinado -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.14" height="0.8" position="0.05 1.9 0" rotation="0 0 -25" material="color: #0f172a; metalness: 0.8; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.18" height="0.2" position="-0.15 2.3 0" rotation="0 0 -25" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Tornillo de enfoque macro/micro -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.16" height="0.4" position="-0.4 0.9 0" rotation="90 0 0" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9"></a-cylinder>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 4. FIGURA EXACTA: MATRAZ ERLENMEYER DE LABORATORIO CON BURBUJAS (Experimentación / Izquierda Abajo) -->
    <a-entity position="-3.3 -0.8 0.2" rotation="0 25 0">
        <!-- Cuerpo cónico de vidrio pirex transparente -->
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.8" radius-top="0.25" height="1.1" position="0 0.55 0"
            material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.35; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.9; side: double">
        </a-cone>
        <!-- Cuello cilíndrico del matraz -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.24" height="0.65" position="0 1.35 0"
            material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.35; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.9; side: double">
        </a-cylinder>
        <!-- Reborde de la boca del matraz -->
        <a-torus radius="0.24" radius-tubular="0.03" position="0 1.68 0" rotation="90 0 0"
            material="color: #bae6fd; opacity: 0.6; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.8">
        </a-torus>
        <!-- Líquido químico reactivo interior -->
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.75" radius-top="0.45" height="0.6" position="0 0.32 0"
            material="color: #06b6d4; emissive: #0891b2; emissiveIntensity: 0.7; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true">
        </a-cone>
        <!-- Burbujas ascendentes de reacción química -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.05" position="-0.15 0.1 0.1" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: position; to: -0.15 0.62 0.1; dur: 1200; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.065" position="0.2 0.05 -0.1" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: position; to: 0.2 0.62 -0.1; dur: 1600; loop: true; delay: 350; easing: linear">
        </a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.04" position="0 0.12 0.2" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: position; to: 0 0.62 0.2; dur: 1400; loop: true; delay: 700; easing: linear">
        </a-sphere>
        <!-- Soporte / Base trípode -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="0.82" radius-outer="0.9" position="0 0.05 0" rotation="-90 0 0" material="color: #475569; metalness: 0.8"></a-ring>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 5. FIGURA EXACTA: CADENA MOLECULAR DE ADN ROTATORIA (Ciencia / Izquierda Arriba) -->
    <a-entity position="-2.9 1.7 0.3"
        animation="property: rotation; to: 0 360 0; dur: 9000; loop: true; easing: linear"
        animation__pos="property: position; to: -2.9 1.95 0.3; dir: alternate; dur: 2600; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Par 1 -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 0.6 0" rotation="0 0 90" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="-0.45 0.6 0" material="color: #ef4444; emissive: #b91c1c; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0.45 0.6 0" material="color: #3b82f6; emissive: #1d4ed8; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-sphere>
        <!-- Par 2 (Rotado 45°) -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 0.2 0" rotation="0 45 90" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="-0.32 0.2 0.32" material="color: #eab308; emissive: #ca8a04; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0.32 0.2 -0.32" material="color: #22c55e; emissive: #15803d; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-sphere>
        <!-- Par 3 (Rotado 90°) -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 -0.2 0" rotation="90 0 0" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0 -0.2 0.45" material="color: #06b6d4; emissive: #0891b2; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0 -0.2 -0.45" material="color: #a855f7; emissive: #7e22ce; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-sphere>
        <!-- Par 4 (Rotado 135°) -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 -0.6 0" rotation="0 -45 90" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="-0.32 -0.6 -0.32" material="color: #ef4444; emissive: #b91c1c; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0.32 -0.6 0.32" material="color: #3b82f6; emissive: #1d4ed8; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-sphere>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 6. FIGURA EXACTA: LUPA DE OBSERVACIÓN CIENTÍFICA (Derecha Arriba) -->
    <a-entity position="2.9 1.7 0.3" rotation="-15 25 -20"
        animation="property: position; to: 2.9 1.95 0.3; dir: alternate; dur: 2800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"
        animation__rot="property: rotation; to: -10 35 -15; dir: alternate; dur: 3800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Aro exterior dorado con bisel de aumento -->
        <a-torus radius="0.55" radius-tubular="0.04" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.95; roughness: 0.15; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.4"></a-torus>
        <!-- Lente de vidrio óptico transparente -->
        <a-circle radius="0.53" material="color: #a5f3fc; opacity: 0.45; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.9; side: double"></a-circle>
        <!-- Destello de reflejo especular en el cristal -->
        <a-plane width="0.15" height="0.45" position="0.2 0.2 0.01" rotation="0 0 -40" material="color: #ffffff; opacity: 0.6; transparent: true"></a-plane>
        <!-- Mango anatómico de madera noble con latón -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.9" position="0 -0.95 0" material="color: #78350f; roughness: 0.4"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.09" position="0 -1.4 0" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.95; roughness: 0.15"></a-sphere>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 7. FIGURA EXACTA: BOMBILLA DE IDEAS E HIPÓTESIS / EUREKA! (Centro Cúspide) -->
    <a-entity position="0 2.7 0.1"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 2.9 0.1; dir: alternate; dur: 2400; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Globo de bombilla de cristal -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.45" material="color: #fef08a; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 0.9"></a-sphere>
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.42" radius-top="0.22" height="0.3" position="0 -0.32 0" material="color: #fef08a; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 0.9"></a-cone>
        <!-- Rosca metálica y contacto eléctrico -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.2" height="0.25" position="0 -0.58 0" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0 -0.72 0" material="color: #334155; metalness: 0.8"></a-sphere>
        <!-- Filamento incandescente de tungsteno -->
        <a-torus radius="0.16" radius-tubular="0.02" position="0 0 0" rotation="0 0 0" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #ffffff; emissiveIntensity: 2"></a-torus>
        <!-- Rayos de inspiración / destellos de ideas -->
        <a-octahedron radius="0.1" position="-0.7 0.3 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: scale; to: 1.5 1.5 1.5; dir: alternate; dur: 800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"></a-octahedron>
        <a-octahedron radius="0.1" position="0.7 0.3 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: scale; to: 1.5 1.5 1.5; dir: alternate; dur: 800; loop: true; delay: 400; easing: easeInOutSine"></a-octahedron>
        <a-octahedron radius="0.1" position="0 0.8 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: scale; to: 1.5 1.5 1.5; dir: alternate; dur: 800; loop: true; delay: 200; easing: easeInOutSine"></a-octahedron>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 8. GRAN LIBRO ABIERTO DE METODOLOGÍA (Centro Abajo) -->
    <a-entity position="0 -1.35 0.5" rotation="28 0 0"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 -1.22 0.5; dir: alternate; dur: 3200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Lomo central dorado pulido -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.08" height="1.6" position="0 0 -0.05" rotation="90 0 0" material="color: #d97706; metalness: 0.85; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Página Izquierda Abierta -->
        <a-box width="1.15" height="0.06" depth="1.55" position="-0.56 0.05 0" rotation="0 0 14" material="color: #fffbeb; roughness: 0.9"></a-box>
        <a-box width="1.2" height="0.04" depth="1.6" position="-0.58 0.01 0" rotation="0 0 14" material="color: #1e1b4b; roughness: 0.4"></a-box>
        <!-- Diagramas científicos impresos en página izquierda -->
        <a-plane width="0.8" height="1.15" position="-0.54 0.09 0" rotation="-90 14 0" material="color: #0284c7; opacity: 0.45; transparent: true"></a-plane>
        <!-- Página Derecha Abierta -->
        <a-box width="1.15" height="0.06" depth="1.55" position="0.56 0.05 0" rotation="0 0 -14" material="color: #fffbeb; roughness: 0.9"></a-box>
        <a-box width="1.2" height="0.04" depth="1.6" position="0.58 0.01 0" rotation="0 0 -14" material="color: #1e1b4b; roughness: 0.4"></a-box>
        <!-- Fórmulas y notas en página derecha -->
        <a-plane width="0.8" height="1.15" position="0.54 0.09 0" rotation="-90 -14 0" material="color: #d97706; opacity: 0.45; transparent: true"></a-plane>
        <!-- Cinta separadora dorada -->
        <a-box width="0.1" height="0.02" depth="1.75" position="0 0.08 0.1" material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-box>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 9. EL TEXTO FLOTANTE ULTRA-LEGIBLE CON CAMBIO DE COLOR EN 60 FPS (Al frente de todo: Z = 0.9) -->
    <a-entity position="0 0.4 0.9"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 0.55 0.9; dir: alternate; dur: 2500; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">

        <!-- Panel de contraste protector oscuro (Garantiza lectura 100% nítida en cualquier fondo) -->
        <a-plane width="4.9" height="2.2" position="0 0.1 -0.06"
            material="color: #030712; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true; roughness: 0.5">
        </a-plane>

        <!-- Insignia Superior -->
        <a-plane width="3.2" height="0.38" position="0 0.98 0.01"
            material="color: #0f172a; opacity: 0.95; transparent: true">
            <a-text value="🎓 METODO CIENTIFICO • UNIDAD I" align="center" color="#38bdf8" width="3.6" position="0 0 0.02"></a-text>
        </a-plane>

        <!-- CAPA GLOW TRASERA (Cambia de color automáticamente con app.js) -->
        <a-text 
            class="texto-glow-cambiante"
            value="Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de Metodologia\nde Investigacion" 
            color="#00f0ff" 
            align="center" 
            width="4.9"
            line-height="62"
            position="0.02 0.22 -0.01">
        </a-text>

        <!-- CAPA PRINCIPAL FRONTAL (Cambia de color en bucle continuo a 60 FPS) -->
        <a-text 
            class="texto-color-cambiante"
            value="Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de Metodologia\nde Investigacion" 
            color="#ffffff" 
            align="center" 
            width="4.7"
            line-height="62"
            position="0 0.22 0.02">
        </a-text>

        <!-- SUBTÍTULO: LAS 4 FASES DEL MÉTODO CIENTÍFICO (Cambia de color) -->
        <a-text 
            class="texto-acento-cambiante"
            value="✦ Observacion  •  Hipotesis  •  Experimentacion  •  Tesis ✦" 
            color="#fbbf24" 
            align="center" 
            width="3.6"
            position="0 -0.58 0.02">
        </a-text>
    </a-entity>

</a-entity>
